sources.title: 《世宗实录》卷47 世宗十二年三月十八日取才书目
sources.quality_notes: Star-fate and divination subsection names 紫微數, 五行精紀 and 三車一覽. Scope is the list and its approval. Exact exam-copy editions, physical glyphs, and modern Ziwei rule identity are unbound.
sources.locator: kda_11203018_002; Taebaeksan vol.47 leaf 28a; NIKH facsimile vol.3 p.225

sources.title: 《世宗实录》卷107 世宗二十七年三月五日书云观习业
sources.quality_notes: The approved proposal selected ten blind practitioners/students, assigned instructors and set the meeting frequency. It does not name books, classroom activity or exact rules.
sources.locator: kda_12703005_001; Taebaeksan vol.107 leaf 15b; NIKH facsimile vol.4 p.609

sources.title: 《经国大典》礼典〈取才〉命课学
sources.quality_notes: Names 紫微數, 五行精記 and 徐子平 as texts for reading from the work. Finalization of the code and the physical witness dates are separate. No claim to have read a 1485 print leaf.

sources.title: 《经国大典注解》后集礼典〈取才〉五行精记条
sources.quality_notes: Identifies the legal title 五行精記 by Song author attribution 廖仲 / 伯禮 and scope of the collected 三命 writings; does not identify a physical exam copy. Kyujanggak GK01271 catalog dates its commentary witness to 1555; its digitized leaf was not collated.

sources.title: 《仁祖实录》卷45 仁祖二十二年三月二十一日沈器远供词与对质
sources.quality_notes: In the same article, Sim Gi-won says relatives studied 紫微斗數 and asked time/month and drew charts; in confrontation he calls their practice 紫微數. Testimony is scoped to the reported family activity; no verified algorithm, physical chart or back-projection of the naming equivalence to 1430.
sources.locator: wpa_12203021_004; Taebaeksan vol.45 leaf 12b; NIKH facsimile vol.35 p.176

sources.title: 《正祖实录》卷47 正祖二十一年十一月十二日命课学试讲变更
sources.quality_notes: The approved recommendation distinguishes the fate-calculation books 徐子平 and 範圍數 from date selection and substitutes 袁天綱 and 協吉通義 for this oral examination. It does not identify the 徐子平 edition or describe private practice.
sources.locator: kva_12111012_003; Taebaeksan vol.47 leaf 44a; NIKH facsimile vol.47 p.54

sources.title: 高丽大学《新編三車一覽子平淵源註解》乙亥字三册
sources.quality_notes: Tian and Ren are components of the same set. Catalog states 中宗15(1518) and numeric 1518, whereas the reign-year resolves to 1520. Neither the physical impression year nor identity with the 1430 exam object is decided by this record.

sources.title: 韩国学中央研究院《实录辞典》三车一览条
sources.quality_notes: Reports a 1517 preface and a 1518 Xiong reissue; the reader did not inspect the stated source leaves. Retrospective paratext dating neither resolves the catalog contradiction nor dates the Korean metal-type impression.

sources.title: 高丽大学《五行精紀》乙亥字残本书目
sources.quality_notes: One bibliographic control record for an incomplete set. Sampled books cover vols.18–21 and 26–29. The catalog attributes it to the reign of Joseon Myeongjong; individual physical dates and link to the earlier exam exemplar are unbound.
